messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **April, May, September, and October** strike the best balance.

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny days (mid‑70s °F / 24–26 °C), lower humidity, and fewer tourists after the spring break rush. |
| **May** | Similar pleasant weather, plus the start of the summer season means more activities and events. |
| **September** | Still warm (mid‑70s °F / 24–26 °C) but the peak summer crowds have thinned, and you’ll often find better hotel rates. |
| **October** | Mild temperatures, lower humidity, and the tail end of the high season gives you a quieter experience. |

### Quick comparison of typical conditions

| Month | Avg. High (°F) | Avg. Low (°F) | Humidity | Crowds |
|-------|----------------|---------------|----------|--------|
| April | 78 | 63 | 70% | Low |
| May | 80 | 65 | 70% | Medium |
| June | 82 | 68 | 75% | High |
| July | 84 | 70 | 80% | Very High |
| August | 85 | 71 | 80% | Very High |
| September | 83 | 69 | 75% | Medium |
| October | 81 | 67 | 70% | Low |
| November | 79 | 64 | 70% | Low |
| December | 77 | 62 | 70% | Medium |
| January | 76 | 61 | 70% | Medium |
| February | 76 | 61 | 70% | Medium |
| March | 77 | 62 | 70% | Low |

> **Tip:** If you’re a beach‑oriented traveler who wants the warmest water and the most sunshine, the summer months (June–August) are ideal, but expect higher prices and larger crowds. If you prefer a quieter trip with comfortable temperatures and better deals, stick to the shoulder seasons (April–May, September–October).

So, if you’re looking for the sweet spot between great weather, manageable crowds, and reasonable prices, aim for **April, May, September, or October**.
